info.title: Shoelaxe Dashboard API
info.description: Generated from the zod schemas the route handlers validate with — do not edit by hand. See docs/API.md for the narrative documentation.

post.summary: Synchronous per-item ingest from StockX email and Google Sheet
post.description:
Machine ingest. The payload is identity + cost/quantity only: the Google Sheet no longer sends image URLs or margins. Margins are resolved server-side (listing override → group → system default). Item failures surface as per-item outcomes inside a 200; the batch continues.

Each item runs in its own transaction. Shopify is enqueued, never called inline. After those transactions commit, unique SKUs are looked up on KicksDB GOAT (`GET /v3/goat/products?query=SKU`) and catalog fields plus `images[]` URLs are saved.

**Consumed by:** machine: Apps Script (GmailStockX.gs, SheetUpdater.gs)

**Idempotency:** Per item on (source, source_ref). Replay returns the stored result with idempotent: true.

**Side effects:** price_updates; price_history on real change; audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs (deferred while PUBLISH_TARGET=none); crawl_runs; products catalog from KicksDB GOAT (after item txs; skipped when KICKSDB_API_KEY is unset); media.product_images from KicksDB images[] (source kicksdb)

get.summary: Connection test and batch sizing for Apps Script
get.description:
The script reads accepts_max_items at run start so batch size can change server-side without redeploy.

**Consumed by:** machine: Apps Script (testIngestConnection)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

post.summary: Claim due shopify_sync_jobs and publish a small batch
post.description:
Worker-driven. With PUBLISH_TARGET=none this reports the deferred backlog and never calls Shopify. Apps Script must not call this route.

**Consumed by:** machine: worker drain / local poke

**Idempotency:** Each call claims a different due batch. Safe to retry.

**Side effects:** shopify_sync_jobs; listings.shopify_* ids on success; listings.shopify_sync_error after 5 failures

post.summary: Enqueue one listing for Shopify sync
post.description:
Inserts a shopify_sync_jobs row (queued when PUBLISH_TARGET=shopify, deferred otherwise). Does not call Shopify. A pending row for the listing is a no-op with created=false.

**Consumed by:** machine: Sync now / local poke

**Idempotency:** One pending job per listing (unique where done_at is null).

**Side effects:** shopify_sync_jobs

get.summary: The approval queue, one row per price update
get.description:
Includes auto-approved rows, which render 無需處理 and carry no action. Gap 6 shapes the row: the design draws two *costs* and no current price, but Δ belongs to the price pair — new price against the last human-approved price — so both pairs ship and the columns get relabelled.

**Consumed by:** Screen 1 (價格監控與審批); deep-linked from Screen 8

**Idempotency:** Safe. meta carries {total, page, per_page, total_pages, publishing}.

schema.description: Rows per page; one of 20, 50, 100. 20 matches the design's 每頁 20 筆 selector.
Search text; matched against product name and SKU.

get.summary: Screen 1's four metric cards, and the nav pending badge
get.description:
Takes **no filters** by design (Gap 8): lifetime totals with a 今日 delta, so 通過率 does not change as the user types in the search box. The nav badge and the 待審核 card read the same number from the same call — two sources for one count means they disagree the moment someone approves something.

**Consumed by:** Screen 1 metric cards; shell nav badge

**Idempotency:** Safe. Revalidated after any approve/reject.

get.summary: Screen 2's crawl panel: cadence, last run, next run, today's count
get.description:
Gap 33, with three corrections to the design baked into the shape. 今日爬取次數 counts **runs**, not items. 下次爬取 is meaningless for the manual sheet source, so it is derived from the StockX cadence alone. And the two sources are broken out, because one combined 上次爬取 hides a dead Gmail trigger behind a fresh manual sync.

`cadence_minutes` is a display mirror of the Apps Script trigger, which the server cannot read.

**Consumed by:** Screen 2 (爬取排程)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

get.summary: Every group with its rule and product count
get.description:
Never empty: 預設分組 cannot be deleted or lose `is_default`.

**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (left rail); group pickers on Screens 5 and 7

**Idempotency:** Safe.

post.description:
The design has the button but no modal board; the frontend brief defines it (Gap 34).

**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (新增分組)

**Idempotency:** Not idempotent; a duplicate name is `conflict`.

**Side effects:** product_groups; audit_log

delete.summary: Delete a group and reassign its products to 預設分組
delete.description:
Gap 18: reassignment re-runs §5 for every affected listing, which at 24 products × 8 sizes is a fan-out rather than a request — hence 202 and a job, and Screen 6 needs JobProgress too.

Gap 14, resolved: a non-empty group is **never refused**, so `group_not_empty` is dead and is not in this list.

**Consumed by:** Screen 6 (刪除分組確認彈窗)

**Idempotency:** A second delete is `not_found`.

**Side effects:** product_groups; products.product_group_id; jobs (group_rule_recompute); audit_log

get.summary: One group, its rule, and Screen 4's scope counts
get.description:
Gap 10. The 96 / 78 / 18 counts must be known before submit and cannot be computed client-side — the product table is paginated and per-size data only loads on expand. Two invariants hold: `all = group_rule_only + overridden_only`, and `all + ineligible.total = listing_count`. Inactive and rejected listings are counted as ineligible, never inside a scope.

**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (header); Screen 4 (scope radio); Screen 6 (name + count)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

patch.description:
Name only. Every margin change routes through /apply, because changing a rule without saying which sizes it overwrites is exactly the ambiguity Screen 4's scope radio exists to remove.

**Consumed by:** Screen 3

**Idempotency:** Idempotent.

**Side effects:** product_groups; audit_log

post.summary: 批次更新分組利潤 — 202 and a job
post.description:
Field presence *is* the checkbox: an absent margin means 不更新. `all` overwrites size overrides, `group_rule_only` skips them, `overridden_only` resets them to the new rule.

Five rapid clicks return the **same** job id by design, so a 409 `job_already_running` is not an error state — adopt the running job (its id is in `details.job_id`) and switch straight to state C. Per Gap 1 the batch bypasses the approval band, writing `price_history` with `actor_label='分組批次更新'`.

**Consumed by:** Screen 4 (套用)

**Idempotency:** Single-flighted by `jobs_active_scope_unique (kind, scope_key)`.

**Side effects:** jobs (group_apply); job_items; audit_log

post.summary: Screen 4's 預覽 block — a pure read that writes nothing
post.description:
Gap 15. 「以成本 HK$1,200 計算 … 目前售價 → 更新後」 needs the margin precedence chain, the x49/x99 rounding rule and the per-scope selection, all of which live server-side. POST only because it takes a body. The sample cost defaults to the group's median `base_cost` so the illustrative figure is explainable rather than arbitrary.

**Consumed by:** Screen 4 states A and B

**Idempotency:** Safe despite the method: no rows are written.

delete.summary: Remove products from a group, back to 預設分組
delete.description:
**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (row action)

**Idempotency:** Removing a product that is not a member is a no-op.

**Side effects:** products.product_group_id; price_history (分組批次更新); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

post.summary: Add products to a group, moving them out of their current one
post.description:
Every product is in exactly one group, so adding is moving. The response reports what moved and from where, so Screen 5's 將移出 Nike Dunk 系列 warning is confirmed by the server rather than inferred. Recomputes with the new group's margins; per Gap 1 that is a human approval and bypasses the band.

**Consumed by:** Screen 5 (新增產品彈窗)

**Idempotency:** Adding a product already in the group is a no-op, not an error.

**Side effects:** products.product_group_id; price_history (分組批次更新); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

get.summary: Find a running job by kind and scope
get.description:
Without `kind` + `scope_key` + `status` filters Screen 4 cannot rehydrate a running job after a reload and Screen 3 cannot show its apply-in-progress banner — so it would start a second job instead of adopting the first.

**Consumed by:** Screen 4 (rehydrate); Screen 3 (running banner); Screen 2

**Idempotency:** Safe.

schema.description: Rows per page; one of 20, 50, 100. 20 matches the design's 每頁 20 筆 selector.

get.summary: Job progress, result summary and failed items
get.description:
A **pure read**: polling it does not drive the work, so a closed tab does not stall the job.

Gap 16 is what makes states D and E renderable — `done / total` alone cannot produce 更新尺寸數 or name a failed size, because `job_items` stores only `listing_id`. `meta.worker.heartbeat_at` is how state C tells 'slow' from '背景服務未運行', which look identical from the browser.

`queued` is its own state and must render 排隊中, never `0 / 96`, which reads as stalled.

**Consumed by:** Screen 4 states C–E; Screen 2 settings recompute; Screen 6 delete

**Idempotency:** Safe. Poll ~1s while running, back off after 30s.

post.summary: 重試失敗項目 — seed a new job from the failures only
post.description:
**Consumed by:** Screen 4 state E

**Idempotency:** Single-flighted on (kind, scope_key) like the original.

**Side effects:** jobs; job_items

get.summary: One size, with its sources, resolved margins and last 20 history rows
get.description:
§6.2 also promised an inbound log; Gap 32 found it has no consumer, so it is not returned. An unread field is a field that rots.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (expanded size row)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

post.summary: Accept the held price for one size
post.description:
`not_pending` (409) is the **expected** race, not a failure: someone else approved it, or a newer update superseded it. It must read as 「此筆已被更新的價格取代」 and trigger a row refetch.

**Consumed by:** Screen 1 (確認); Screen 8 (per-size approve)

**Idempotency:** Second call on the same listing returns `not_pending`, never a double approval.

**Side effects:** price_history (listing_price); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

Cost and stock keep syncing; the listing is not re-queued until a human reactivates it.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (per-size 上架狀態)

**Idempotency:** Idempotent: already-inactive returns the listing unchanged.

**Side effects:** price_history (listing_status); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs (→ draft)

get.summary: Full price history for one size, filterable and exportable
get.description:
Serves two consumers with one endpoint (Gap 20): `limit` returns the newest N for the 近 6 次變更 chart, paging returns the table below it. `format=csv` streams a file rather than an envelope.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (per-size 價格變動紀錄 and the six-bar chart)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

schema.description: Rows per page; one of 20, 50, 100. 20 matches the design's 每頁 20 筆 selector.
Return the newest N rows and ignore paging. Used by the 近 6 次變更 chart.

patch.summary: Set or clear one size's margin override
patch.description:
**Null clears the override**, falling back to the group rule and then the system default; an absent key leaves the field alone. Recomputes the price and re-runs the §5 decision.

**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (inline per-size edit); Screen 8 (尺寸設定 popover)

**Idempotency:** Not idempotent: writes price_history when the price actually changes.

**Side effects:** price_history (margin_percent / margin_fixed / listing_price); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs when the approved price moves

post.summary: Manual price adjustment, bypassing the approval band
post.description:
§5 grants this explicitly: a human setting the price deliberately *is* the approval. Gap 22 notes no screen surfaced it — the 統一售價 panel now does, behind a confirmation that names the bypass. Recorded as `manual_price` with the user as actor.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (統一售價 → 手動指定售價)

**Idempotency:** Not idempotent.

**Side effects:** price_history (manual_price); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

Re-runs the §5 decision against the current cost, so a listing that sat inactive through several crawls can come back as `pending_price` rather than silently republishing a stale price.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (per-size 上架狀態)

**Idempotency:** Idempotent while the decision is unchanged.

**Side effects:** price_history (listing_status); audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

post.summary: Reject the held price, keeping the old one live
post.description:
On `pending_new` the listing becomes `rejected`; on `pending_price` it returns to `approved` at the **old** price, which stays live and published.

**Consumed by:** Screen 1 (拒絕); Screen 8

**Idempotency:** Second call returns `not_pending`.

**Side effects:** price_history (listing_status); audit_log

post.summary: Approve a set of sizes, or every size of one product
post.description:
Partial by nature — one of the ids may have been superseded a second ago — so it answers 200 with a per-id result rather than failing the batch.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (核准所有尺寸); Screen 1 selection

**Idempotency:** Re-running reports `not_pending` per already-approved id rather than erroring.

**Side effects:** price_history; audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

get.summary: The signed-in user, plus publishing state and a settings snapshot
get.description:
Read once in the dashboard layout and seeded into context. Reading `publishing.enabled` from each screen's own list query would render sync copy for the ~200ms before it resolves.

**Consumed by:** Shell (nav, publishing banner); Screens 2, 3, 4, 8 for formula previews

**Idempotency:** Safe; cached for the session.

get.summary: Product-level list with tab counts, group filter and per-product aggregates
get.description:
`meta.counts` respects `q` and `group_id` and **ignores** `status`, so switching tabs does not move the numbers on the tabs. Product status is derived from the six listing statuses by the Gap 4 rule; the aggregates object is Gap 13's, shared with Screens 3 and 5.

**Consumed by:** Screen 7 (產品列表); Screen 3 table; Screen 5 (新增產品)

**Idempotency:** Safe. meta carries pagination, counts and publishing.

schema.description: Search text; matched against product name and SKU.
Rows per page; one of 20, 50, 100. 20 matches the design's 每頁 20 筆 selector.

get.summary: Everything above the fold on Screen 8: content, images, every size, aggregates
get.description:
**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (產品詳情); Screen 3 row expand; Screen 9 hydration

**Idempotency:** Safe.

patch.summary: The Screen 8 draft, committed transactionally in one call
patch.description:
Applies everything or nothing, so there is no partial-failure state for the save — but the §5 decision differs per listing, and the response reports that mix so the UI can say 「3 個尺寸已更新，2 個尺寸的新售價需審核」 (Gap 24).

Absent means untouched, `null` means clear, a value means set. SKU and sizes are immutable, and only in-house source fields are writable — a write to a `stockx` row is `source_read_only`, which should be unreachable because that card renders no editable control.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (儲存變更); Screen 9 stages into this draft

**Idempotency:** One transaction. A failure on any listing commits nothing.

**Side effects:** price_history per changed field; audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs per repriced listing

get.summary: Product-scoped price history, all sizes or one
get.description:
Gap 21. §6.2 offered only the per-size endpoint, yet described it as supporting 'filter by size/all' — which is meaningless on an endpoint already scoped to one size, and is good evidence the intent was product-scoped throughout. Screen 8's bottom table has a 尺寸 column.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (價格變更紀錄, 匯出); /products/[sku]/history

**Idempotency:** Safe.

schema.description: Rows per page; one of 20, 50, 100. 20 matches the design's 每頁 20 筆 selector.
Return the newest N rows and ignore paging. Used by the 近 6 次變更 chart.

post.description:
JPG/PNG, ≤2MB, max 8 per SKU. The body is `multipart/form-data`, which this generator cannot express, so it is documented here rather than typed. Answers with the whole gallery so an optimistic gallery has one thing to reconcile against.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (上架圖片 dropzone)

**Idempotency:** Not idempotent: each call adds a row.

**Side effects:** media.product_images; Supabase Storage object; shopify_sync_jobs

delete.description:
Deleting the primary promotes the next by `sort_order`; a product with no image publishes as `draft` rather than `active`.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (刪除)

**Idempotency:** Idempotent: a second delete is `not_found`.

**Side effects:** media.product_images; Supabase Storage object; shopify_sync_jobs

patch.summary: Set an image primary, or move it in the order
patch.description:
**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (主圖 badge)

**Idempotency:** Idempotent.

**Side effects:** media.product_images; shopify_sync_jobs

post.description:
The full id list in display order, primary first. Also expressible inside the Screen 8 draft as `image_order`; this endpoint is the standalone path for a reorder committed on its own.

**Consumed by:** Screen 8 (拖曳排序)

**Idempotency:** Idempotent: the payload is the desired end state, not a delta.

**Side effects:** media.product_images.sort_order; shopify_sync_jobs

post.summary: 套用至所有尺寸 — one margin rule across a product's sizes
post.description:
Gap 11. The nested PATCH can express this, but only by making the client enumerate every listing id for a single user intent. Reuses the group-apply scope vocabulary so both drive the same component; N is small enough to stay synchronous.

**Consumed by:** Screen 3 (套用至所有尺寸); Screen 8 (批次編輯)

**Idempotency:** One transaction across the product's listings.

**Side effects:** price_history; audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs

post.summary: Screen 7's 批次操作: 指派分組 / 下架 / 重新上架
post.description:
Gap 19. §6.2 admits the menu is undefined in the design; it is defined here, operating on the **selection** and never on the whole filter. Inherently partial, so it answers 200 with a per-SKU result — treating the status code as the answer would silently lose the failures.

**Consumed by:** Screen 7 (批次操作)

**Idempotency:** Re-running a completed action is a no-op per SKU.

**Side effects:** price_history; audit_log; shopify_sync_jobs; jobs (group_rule_recompute) on assign_group

get.description:
Identical parameters to the list minus paging — the export is of the filter, not of the page on screen. Streams `text/csv`, so it is fetched outside the envelope-typed client.

**Consumed by:** Screen 7 (匯出清單)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

schema.description: Search text; matched against product name and SKU.

get.summary: Thresholds, the system default margin, the rounding toggle
get.description:
**Consumed by:** Screen 2 (系統配置)

**Idempotency:** Safe. The same values ride on /me as a snapshot for formula previews.

patch.summary: Save changed settings, returning the recompute job when one was needed
patch.description:
Gap 7. Changing a threshold, the default margin or the rounding toggle re-prices every listing resolving to the system default, which is a worker fan-out. The server answers **202** when it enqueued and 200 when nothing needed recomputing, with the identical body either way — so branch on `job`, not on the status code. Without it the screen shows a green tick while prices keep moving for the next minute.

Disabling the default margin must never retroactively unapprove a live price.

**Consumed by:** Screen 2 (儲存設定)

**Idempotency:** Saving unchanged values writes nothing and returns `job: null`.

**Side effects:** pricing_settings; jobs (settings_recompute); audit_log

get.summary: The allow-list. A session is valid iff its email is on it
get.description:
Gap 28 adds the three fields the design does not draw and cannot work without: `added_at`, `added_by_name`, and `is_self` so 移除 can be disabled on your own row. At six rows the search box filters client-side.

**Consumed by:** Screen 10 (使用者)

**Idempotency:** Safe.

post.summary: Grant access to an email address
post.description:
No invitation email — creating an allowed user just lets them sign in. A duplicate address is `conflict`, which is exactly what the design's 需有效且未被使用 describes.

**Consumed by:** Screen 10 (新增使用者帳號)

**Idempotency:** Not idempotent; re-adding an existing address is `conflict`.

**Side effects:** allowed_users; audit_log

delete.description:
The path carries the lowercased, URL-encoded address. **Removing the last remaining user is refused with 409** — the seed is a single row, and one careless click would lock everyone out permanently with no way back in. Nothing client-side can enforce that, which is why it is here.

**Consumed by:** Screen 10 (移除)

**Idempotency:** A second delete is `not_found`.

**Side effects:** allowed_users; audit_log

get.summary: Screen 2's 爬蟲服務運行中 indicators — two of them, not one
get.description:
A stale last run means the Apps Script trigger stopped; a stale worker heartbeat means the background service died. Same symptom in the browser, different fix, so one combined light would be useless. Distinct from the unauthenticated `/api/health` liveness probe, which stops querying the database after its first success.

**Consumed by:** Screen 2 (爬取排程 panel)

**Idempotency:** Safe.
